changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE push_subscriptions ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, user_id BIGINT NOT NULL, endpoint TEXT NOT NULL, p256dh VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, auth VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, date_creation TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, date_modification TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CONSTRAINT uk_push_subscriptions_endpoint UNIQUE (endpoint), CONSTRAINT fk_push_subscriptions_user FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE ); CREATE INDEX idx_push_subscriptions_user ON push_subscriptions(user_id);

changeSet.sql:
INSERT INTO habilitations (nom) SELECT 'NOTIF_BL_EXPEDIE' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM habilitations WHERE nom = 'NOTIF_BL_EXPEDIE');
INSERT INTO roles_habilitations (role_id, habilitation_id) SELECT r.id, h.id FROM roles r JOIN habilitations h ON h.nom = 'NOTIF_BL_EXPEDIE' WHERE r.nom = 'ROLE_ADMIN' ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
